name: Field group anchors
description: Adds HTML anchors to field group elements.
project_description:
The Field Group Anchors module creates an index with anchors to navigate to the different field groups within the content. This index can be placed as a field using a field collection provided by the module, or through a block.

For now, the module only works with nodes.

 Features 
 Create an index using the field groups labels.

 In this moment it only works with node and the full view mode.

 Post-Installation 
 Field groups need to be created, and each field group that you want to use must be assigned an ID (configuration of each field group). In the module settings, you need to specify which node types you want to use the module with and whether you want to use it via a pseudo field or a block.

 Additional Requirements 
 The module require field group and hux modules.
